assets.name: menu_grove_ambient
assets.prompt: Instrumental ancient Slavic woodland fantasy background music. Peaceful sacred oak grove, warm soft bowed strings, delicate gusli and wooden lyre, sparse tiny hand bells, breathy wooden flute and gentle forest wind texture. Calm welcoming mysterious atmosphere, very restrained melody, soft dynamics, no prominent drums, no voices, no modern synthesizers. Steady continuous arrangement suitable for a seamless game menu loop.
assets.label: Menu i osada — Szept Gaju

assets.name: battle_loop
assets.prompt: Instrumental Slavic folk fantasy tactical battle background music, steady lively frame drums and deep hand drums, driving low bowed strings, sparse ancient gusli and wooden flute motif. Dark forest magic, brave tense atmosphere, moderate intensity with plenty of space for game sound effects. Natural acoustic instruments, continuous rhythmic arrangement suitable for looping, no vocals, no electric guitars, no electronic dance beat.
assets.label: Walka — Straż Peruna

assets.name: victory_sting
assets.prompt: Instrumental very short Slavic fantasy victory fanfare. One uplifting resolved major phrase played by warm bowed strings and a wooden lyre, one celebratory frame drum hit, ending in a bright clear hand bell. Brief triumphant game victory jingle with a natural final decay, no voices, no repeating groove, no modern synth.
assets.label: Zwycięstwo

assets.name: defeat_sting
assets.prompt: Instrumental very short gentle Slavic fantasy defeat cue. A soft descending bowed string phrase and one low muted frame drum, a warm wooden lyre final note, calm reassuring ending with a natural decay. Mild disappointment without horror or despair, no vocals, no harsh impacts, no repeating rhythm.
assets.label: Porażka

assets.name: village_upgrade_sting
assets.prompt: Instrumental very short warm Slavic village building completion jingle. A dry wooden knock, a brief ascending wooden lyre and gusli flourish, warm strings and one small clear bell at the resolved ending. Hopeful uplifting acoustic fantasy reward cue, no vocals, no electronic synthesizer, no long drum rhythm.
